'''Viray''' was a member of [[Dagger Wing]], imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] along with the rest of the squadron for bombing thousands of Imperial civilians. During the [[Invasion of Belsavis]] the Republic decided to pardon Dagger Wing and return them to active duty. [[Havoc Squad]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] fought through Belsavis to re-assemble the Dagger Wing, rescuing Viray from a firefight he and a fellow [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Tobin Harlan]] were in. After all members of the squadron were accounted for, Guard Captain [[Zess]] arranged for their transit to [[Macula Station]], from where the pilots were able to rejoin the war effort.
